description: One draw hashes: seed as 8 bytes big-endian, then entityId, behavior, rule and site as UTF-8 strings each preceded by its byte length as 4 bytes big-endian, then the counter as 8 bytes big-endian. The counter of a (rule, site) pair of one entity starts at 0 and advances by one per draw. The result is the first 8 bytes of SHA-256 as an unsigned big-endian integer shifted right by 11 (53 bits), divided by 2^53. chance(p) is true when the result is below p.
